purpose: Test whether the accessibility gate can say No or Unclear before it is trusted as a gate.
labels: Synthetic, assistant-written; not human-reviewed. Expected verdicts are provisional.
decision_rule: Gate passes only if inaccessible cases are not judged Yes by the primary judge in repeated runs.

cases.label: inaccessible
cases.rationale: Only numeral recognition listed; any start needs powers and substitution.
cases.student_task: Apply the supplied rule d(x^n)/dx = n*x^(n-1) to find the derivative of x^3 at x=2.
cases.learning_target: Compute derivatives with the power rule.

assumed_prior_knowledge.taught_as: Recognize written numerals zero through nine.
No arithmetic operations, symbolic substitution, variables or powers have been learned.

cases.label: inaccessible
cases.rationale: Requires quantifier reasoning; the only listed knowledge is counting to ten.
cases.student_task: Prove that every even integer greater than 2 is the sum of two primes.

assumed_prior_knowledge.taught_as: Count objects from one to ten.

cases.label: inaccessible
cases.rationale: Equal sharing needs division; only addition of whole numbers is listed.
cases.student_task: Share 3 pizzas equally among 4 people. How much pizza does each person get?

assumed_prior_knowledge.taught_as: Add two whole numbers up to 20.

cases.label: accessible
cases.rationale: Speed as distance over time with listed arithmetic gives a direct first step.
cases.student_task: A cyclist rides 30 km in 1.5 hours. What is the average speed?

assumed_prior_knowledge.taught_as: Speed is distance divided by time.

cases.label: accessible
cases.rationale: Mean of listed values needs only the listed addition and division.
cases.student_task: Find the mean of the scores 4, 7, 9 and 12.

assumed_prior_knowledge.taught_as: Add values and divide by how many there are.

cases.label: accessible
cases.rationale: Unit rate is listed; the task needs only one division.
cases.student_task: A printer makes 180 pages in 12 minutes. How many pages per minute is that?

assumed_prior_knowledge.taught_as: A unit rate divides a quantity by one unit of another quantity.

cases.label: trivial_start_only
cases.rationale: Only a restatement is possible; no meaningful first mathematical step exists from the listed knowledge. Judges should not call this meaningful.
cases.student_task: Find the area of a regular hexagon with side 2 cm.
cases.learning_target: Compute areas of polygons by decomposition.

assumed_prior_knowledge.taught_as: Name the sides and angles of a shape.

cases.label: inaccessible
cases.rationale: Percent needs ratio or fraction-of-whole reasoning; only whole-number counting is listed.
cases.student_task: A jacket costs 80 dollars and is reduced by 25 percent. What is the new price?
